templates.name: PostgreSQL
templates.compose:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_NAME}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:5432"
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  data:
notes: Reachable on the host port you set. Leave it internal by removing the port mapping if only other containers need it.

templates.name: MySQL
templates.compose:
services:
  db:
    image: mysql:8
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ${DB_NAME}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${ROOT_PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:3306"
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  data:
notes: The root password is required on first start.

templates.name: Redis
templates.compose:
services:
  redis:
    image: redis:7
    command: redis-server --save 60 1
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:6379"
    volumes:
      - data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  data:
notes: No password by default. Add '--requirepass yourpassword' to the command for auth.

templates.name: InfluxDB
templates.compose:
services:
  influxdb:
    image: influxdb:2
    environment:
      DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_MODE: setup
      DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_USERNAME: ${ADMIN_USER}
      DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_PASSWORD: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_ORG: ${ORG}
      DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_BUCKET: ${BUCKET}
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:8086"
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/influxdb2
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  data:
notes: The web UI and API are on the host port you set.

templates.name: Adminer
templates.compose:
services:

    restart: unless-stopped
notes: A lightweight UI that connects to an existing database — enter the DB host, user and password when you open it.

templates.name: RabbitMQ
templates.compose:
services:
  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3-management
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: ${USER}
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: ${PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "${MGMT_PORT}:15672"
      - "${AMQP_PORT}:5672"
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/rabbitmq
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  data:
notes: The management UI is on the management port; apps connect on the AMQP port.

templates.name: MinIO
templates.compose:
services:
  minio:
    image: quay.io/minio/minio:latest
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${ROOT_USER}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${ROOT_PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "${API_PORT}:9000"
      - "${CONSOLE_PORT}:9001"
    volumes:
      - data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  data:
notes: The console is on the console port; S3 clients use the API port.

templates.name: Sonarr
templates.compose:
services:
  sonarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:latest
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: Etc/UTC
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:8989"
    volumes:
      - config:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  config:
notes: Runs as PUID/PGID 1000; change them in the compose to match your media user. Point its download/media paths at a shared volume after first run.
